description: The native libraries of the dxFeed Graal Native SDK: the dxFeed Java API compiled with GraalVM Native Image into a shared library with a C API, for Windows, Linux and macOS. Used by DxFeed.Graal.Net. The build variant oracle: Oracle GraalVM, -O3 and the Serial GC, no macOS x64.

VisioForge Virtual Camera SDK push API: send your own video frames and audio samples to the VisioForge Virtual Camera, which Zoom, OBS Studio and browsers see as a webcam, and to the Virtual Audio Card, a DirectShow microphone.
Sample job executor plugins for PluginJobRunner (MergeSortArray), demonstrating the IJobExecutor contract on RuntimePluggableClassFactory.
Job executor contract for PluginJobRunner: IJobExecutor, IJobExecutionContext and typed result types for building RuntimePluggableClassFactory-based job plugins.
Domain and persistence model for PluginJobRunner: job entities and the EF Core JobDbContext backing the Quartz-scheduled job runner.

ForkForward.Mediator.Contracts is the contracts package of ForkForward.Mediator, a community fork of MediatR: the request, response and notification contracts (IRequest, INotification, IStreamRequest, Unit) of MediatR.Contracts 2.0.1, without the mediator itself. Independent project: not affiliated…
Shared framework library for Slay the Spire 2 mods.

Add it to the app you run, and Sightline, a live and editable map of your .NET solution, starts beside it whenever you run a Debug build. Web apps also answer /sightline with the map. Nothing is added to Release builds.

A high-performance, fully custom-drawn KumikoUI DataGrid control for the Uno Platform. Renders via SkiaSharp (SKXamlCanvas) on Windows (WinUI), desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux), WebAssembly, Android and iOS, reusing the same engine as KumikoUI.Maui.

Body-replacement backend for Concord, for hosts running the WaylithCLR fork of CoreCLR. It stages each composed body through the runtime's method body transformer pipeline, and installs nothing on a runtime without that pipeline.
Emit backend for Concord on .NET Framework and mono runtimes, where there is no DynamicILInfo to write a method body through. It emits each composed body through MonoMod's DynamicMethodDefinition.

FluentValidation adapter for InstructorSharp. Use your existing AbstractValidator rules to validate LLM output, with failures fed back to the model as corrective feedback addressed by JSON path.
